facts.fact: Cabinet considered and approved the Zimbabwe National AI Strategy (2026 to 2030) at its Thirty-First meeting on 14 October 2025.
facts.system: Zimbabwe National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2026 to 2030)

facts.fact: Cabinet's briefing says an AI Strategy Implementation Office within the ICT Ministry and a National Digital Regulatory Committee under POTRAZ will be established, and names a National AI Innovation Fund as a proposed flagship, with no amount or allocation given.
